checks.explanation: Interest rates on federal debt have risen as predicted, but annual interest expense has not been confirmed to have reached the roughly $2 trillion figure claimed.

Tariff revenue fell rather than rose year-over-year after the Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs in February 2026 and ordered refunds: FY2026 net receipts (~$163B) came in below FY2025's ~$194.9B, not $100-150 billion higher.
The FY2025 deficit came in at $1.8 trillion, equal to 5.9% of GDP -- an improvement from 6.3% of GDP in FY2024, the opposite direction from the predicted worsening to 6.2%.

sources.title: CBO FY2025 deficit $1.8 trillion, 5.9% of GDP
